productArea.name: Maintenance
productArea.scope: Create, edit, clone, delete, pause, and resume maintenance for selected monitors and status pages, using the available scheduling strategies, timezones, effective ranges, and validation. Monitor configuration and status page editing are outside this area.

entryPoints.directions: Choose Maintenance from the menu, then use a schedule's Edit or Clone link to open its form.
Choose Schedule Maintenance and select its monitors, status pages, and scheduling strategy.
